'''Fashti''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Inania]], a [[Mahea|Mahean]] economy and the nineteenth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city had a population of 18,819,000 at the [[Inania|Inanian]] 1764 census, ranking it the [[List of cities and dependencies by population|eleventh-largest city in the world]] by population. Fashti is the political, financial and cultural centre of [[Inania]].
